scope: All 5445 development pairs; whole pairs of heads h,h+8 are pruned. Keep every MLP, embedding and residual path.
order: Single greedy pass over 48 widening pairs, increasing mean absolute summed paired activation-replacement contrast from the completed component scan; tie by layer/head.
acceptance: Both-member prediction agreement >= .995 overall and >= .99 in every development pair population; pair accuracy >= .99 overall. Reference is the unmodified frozen model.
replay: Freeze mask before loading all 1978 difficult pairs from the already exposed replacement assessment. Verify native accuracy against retained assessment counts. Measure fidelity and accuracy once; do not revise the mask.
role: Exploratory circuit simplification. The replay was not used for pruning but its original model accuracy is already exposed; it is not formal confirmation.
